title: Comparison workspace
idea: Comparison workspace: Selected actual items share an aligned attribute view with deliberate differences and source context.
audience: People who need to compare records within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Differences across a few records determine a decision.
avoidWhen: Too many incomparable attributes would produce decorative density.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic collection layout through its compare records priority and explicit commitment contract: Flag missing or uncertain values rather than inventing equivalence.
navigation: Comparison workspace keeps the current compare records context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Selected actual items share an aligned attribute view with deliberate differences and source context.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to compare records; differences across a few records determine a decision.
composition.priority: Flag missing or uncertain values rather than inventing equivalence.

imagery.role: Support the actual compare records context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Compare one attribute group at a time and keep item identity visible.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the comparison workspace structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no compare records content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Flag missing or uncertain values rather than inventing equivalence.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized compare records content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Flag missing or uncertain values rather than inventing equivalence.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active compare records context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
